items.name: Paths
items.desc: Select one or more paths (Ctrl or Cmd click). Paths with the same Waypoint Order run together; higher orders wait.

items.name: LLM Adapter
items.desc: The language model that writes the actors' lines: ollama (local), stub (no model), anthropic or openai.

items.name: API Key (if needed)
items.desc: The key for anthropic or openai. Leave blank for ollama.

items.name: ▶ Record Arc
items.desc: Runs the selected paths and records the arc.

items.name: optional take label
items.desc: A name for the next take.
